## Career Timeline

- 2026–Present: Iterate — Founder & Creative Director (AI-native marketing agency)
- 2026–Present: Cats Can Dance — Founder (culture platform)
- 2025: Fere.ai — CMO (autonomous AI agents, funded by Ethereal Ventures)
- 2022–2024: SoleSearch — Founder & CEO ($6M+ revenue, 350K+ community, $795K raised)
- 2020–2022: Quartic.ai — Director of Marketing (enterprise AI)
- 2017–2020: Good Capital/Investopad — Partner, Growth & Technology (portfolio: Meesho, Entri, Simsim)
- 2016–2017: Octo — Founding Team, Head of Growth (one of India's first chatbots, acquired by Quartic)
- 2012–2015: Hab Housing — Founder (budget hospitality, bootstrapped $120K+)
- 2011–2012: GetRightPrice — Founding Team (India's first price-comparison engine)
